data.narrative:
Red 6 is a Series B+ stage Defense & Security company that has raised $100M+ to date. The broader Defense & Security sector contains 23 companies across public and private markets; Red 6's comp universe spans 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Traditional peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The narrow peer set—filtered by stage, funding tier, and business proximity—yields fewer than the three datapoints required for statistical reliability. While 23 same-sector companies exist, zero meet the criteria of same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-valuation-tier simultaneously. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity of Defense & Security subsegments and business models.

The absence of a robust bracketing method creates genuine constraint. Valuation of Red 6 therefore depends on bottom-up analysis of the underlying business (revenue visibility, customer concentration, contract runway, technology moats) and qualitative positioning within the identified peer cohort rather than quantitative triangulation. Key uncertainties include customer acquisition trajectory, government procurement cycle exposure, and the company's specific technology differentiation relative to the named competitors. Further data on revenue scale, customer base, and margin profile would be necessary to anchor a defensible range.
